_meta.description: 201 body of POST /api/vehicles/{vehicleId}/invites (rest-api.md §7.5.1), transcribed verbatim from the spec example. The row is for the PATH vehicle; on a multi-vehicle create the sibling rows are NOT returned and this `code` is the one to hand out for all of them. `code` + `expiresAt` are present because the row is `pending`; `acceptedAt` is omitted for the same reason. MYR-368 — `shareUrl` is the contracts-0.22.0 example VERBATIM: the complete SIGNED join link, present exactly where `code` is. Its `k` expiry (1785942245) is `expiresAt` in UNIX seconds, which is the contract's own rule that the two agree.
